## ZBoard v0.0.3 Release Candidate

This prerelease adds shared proxy pools and subscription primary credentials, improves traffic accounting, and refreshes the admin and user interfaces. It covers changes since [v0.0.2](https://github.com/zerodenet/zboard/releases/tag/v0.0.2).

### Before you upgrade

- Back up the database, deployment configuration, credential encryption key, and persistent event directory. Stop all old application writers before running migrations and starting the new version.
- Migrations `0093` and `0094` add subscription credential material and move proxy pools out of individual servers. Existing credentials, pool IDs, encrypted settings, and historical billing attribution are preserved. Pools with the same name remain separate.
- To roll back after the shared-pool migration, use a compatible recovery build or coordinate a database restore. Switching binaries alone leaves the migrated schema in place.
- Automatic enablement of primary credentials is off by default. After verifying node support, an administrator can migrate existing subscriptions individually. The compatibility window defaults to 30 days, and delayed reports from old credentials retain their original billing attribution.

### What changed

- **Nodes and proxy pools.** Multiple VPSs can use one shared proxy pool. Create a pool or select an existing one when adding a server. Pool sync now recovers when a worker loses its lease, skips unchanged configurations, and keeps the previous configuration if publication fails. Node configuration and access revocation still distinguish queued work, confirmed changes, and unknown outcomes. Nodes continue to use SSH for management. Node-initiated enrollment and reverse control for nodes without public ingress are still in design.
- **Subscriptions, orders, and balances.** Manage protocol credentials at the subscription level. Edit subscription expiry and reset settings, and use readable reference numbers for orders and support tickets. This build also updates plan changes, order entitlement snapshots, admin payment collection, balance adjustments, and expired-subscription recovery and cleanup. Cleanup preserves financial records and the data needed to detect duplicate reports.
- **Traffic accounting and retention.** Fix races and handling of replayed or out-of-order reports. Operational statistics are stored separately from billing records, so delayed reports still count against their original owner. Durable queues recover pending work. Per-minute monitoring aggregates are retained for 24 hours, with configurable retention for detailed records and operational history. MySQL readiness checks also accept supported legacy node-statistics schemas.
- **Admin and user interfaces.** Refresh navigation, settings, subscription details, orders, balances, and mobile layouts. Improve plugin loading and retry states, and fix user announcement cards.

### Downloads

- **Docker.** Use `ghcr.io/zerodenet/zboard` with the exact RC tag shown on this release page.
- **Linux amd64.** The backend binary and offline Docker image are listed under **Assets**. The Docker image includes the web console. Verify both archives with `SHA256SUMS`.

### Verification and known issues

- For `v0.0.3-rc.202611170907` (commit `5bba7b2`), full CI and the release build passed. The core MySQL regression suite passed all 492 tests with zero skips. [CI run](https://github.com/zerodenet/zboard/actions/runs/44052667731) · [Release build](https://github.com/zerodenet/zboard/actions/runs/44052667958)
- Production upgrade checks covered shared proxy pools, subscription details, and user announcements on desktop and mobile. Automatic pool sync resumed, and the durable traffic-accounting queue kept processing.
- During that upgrade, migrations took about 4.8 seconds, startup took about 6.1 seconds, and the public readiness endpoint was unavailable for about 8.7 seconds. Timings depend on the deployment and data size.
- Some node reports still receive HTTP `401` authentication or `400` payload-validation responses. The sources and causes are still under investigation. Authentication and billing validation remain active.

## 简体中文

ZBoard v0.0.3 候选版新增共享代理池和订阅主凭证，改进流量入账，并更新后台与用户中心界面。以下为 [v0.0.2](https://github.com/zerodenet/zboard/releases/tag/v0.0.2) 以来的变更。

### 升级前必读

- 备份数据库、部署配置、凭证加密密钥和持久化事件目录。停止所有旧版应用写入后，再执行数据库迁移并启动新版本。
- 迁移 `0093`、`0094` 新增订阅凭证材料，并将代理池从单台服务器中独立出来。已有凭证、池 ID、加密配置和历史计费归属继续保留。同名池各自保留。
- 共享池迁移后如需回滚，请使用兼容修复版本，或协调恢复数据库。仅切换旧二进制会保留迁移后的结构。
- 订阅主凭证默认关闭自动启用。验证节点支持后，由管理员逐条迁移存量订阅。兼容窗口默认 30 天，旧凭证的延迟补报继续按原归属入账。

### 主要变化

- **节点与代理池。** 多台 VPS 可共用同一个代理池。新建服务器时可新建池或选择已有池。同步任务丢失执行租约后可恢复，内容相同则跳过发布，发布失败时保留上一版。节点配置发布和撤权仍区分已排队、已确认和结果未知。节点继续通过 SSH 管理。无公网入口节点的主动接入与反向控制仍在设计中。
- **订阅、订单与余额。** 可按订阅管理协议凭证，编辑到期和重置设置，订单与工单新增可读编号。本版也更新了套餐切换、订单权益快照、管理员收款、余额调整，以及过期订阅的恢复和清理流程。清理时保留财务记录与必要的去重依据。
- **流量入账与数据保留。** 修复节点上报重放、乱序和并发处理问题。运行统计与计费记录独立保存，延迟上报继续按原归属入账。持久队列可恢复待处理记录。分钟级监控汇总保留 24 小时，明细和运行历史可配置保留期限。MySQL 就绪检查兼容受支持的历史节点统计表结构。
- **后台与用户中心。** 调整导航、设置、订阅详情、订单、余额和移动端布局。改进插件加载与失败重试状态，修复用户公告卡片样式。

### 下载

- **Docker。** 使用 `ghcr.io/zerodenet/zboard`，镜像标签填写当前发布页顶部的完整 RC 版本号。
- **Linux amd64。** 后端二进制和离线 Docker 镜像见页面的 **Assets** 区域。Docker 镜像包含 Web 控制台，可用 `SHA256SUMS` 校验两个压缩包。

### 验证与已知问题

- `v0.0.3-rc.202611170907`（提交 `5bba7b2`）的完整 CI 和发布构建均已通过。实际 MySQL 环境的核心回归共通过 492 项，零跳过。[CI 记录](https://github.com/zerodenet/zboard/actions/runs/44052667731) · [发布构建](https://github.com/zerodenet/zboard/actions/runs/44052667958)
- 生产升级后已在桌面与手机端验证共享代理池、订阅详情和用户公告。代理池自动同步已恢复，持久化流量入账队列继续处理。
- 本次生产升级中，迁移约 4.8 秒，应用启动约 6.1 秒，公开就绪接口约有 8.7 秒不可用。耗时随部署环境和数据规模而异。
- 部分节点上报仍返回 HTTP `401` 认证错误或 `400` 报文校验错误，来源和原因仍在排查。认证和计费校验继续生效。
